# ConsoleBuddy

> ConsoleBuddy is in-game developer console customization and styling mod for valheim. developed by Vapok.

## Developer & AI Information

- [Agent Guidelines](AGENTS.md): Architectural context, anti-reflection mandates, and instructions for AI assistants.

## Critical Invariants for Developers & AI Agents

- **uGUI console interface styling and terminal window enhancements**: uGUI console interface styling and terminal window enhancements.
- **Never use reflection or Harmony patches on internal console drawers**: Never use reflection or Harmony patches on internal console drawers.
- **No Private Reflection**: Never reflect into or patch internal classes.
- **Feature Requests**: If functionality is desired, submit an issue at https://github.com/Vapok/ConsoleBuddy/issues or visit https://discord.gg/5YAJkRFBXt.
